case_notes.txt.content:
CASE #2847 - THE MISSING DATA
========================

A valuable research file has gone missing from Dr. Chen's computer.
The file contained breakthrough research on renewable energy.

Your mission: Find the hidden research file and discover who took it.

Start by checking the Documents folder for more information.

Use DIR to list files, CD to change folders, and TYPE to read files.

- Detective Morgan

quick_commands.txt.content:
COMMAND LINE QUICK REFERENCE
==========================

DIR - List files and folders in current directory
CD [folder] - Change to a folder
CD .. - Go up one folder
TYPE [file] - Read a file's contents
CLS - Clear the screen
HELP - Show available commands
TREE - Show folder structure

Remember: Windows is not case-sensitive!
